Venomous_Chelicerae.description: Massive, downward-striking fangs connected to highly developed venom glands. Designed to pierce thick armor and immediately liquefy the prey's internal organs for consumption.

Pedipalp_Grinding_Maw.description: A complex arrangement of specialized, serrated pedipalps and mouthparts designed strictly for mechanical grinding and maceration of tough flesh, requiring intense constitution to power.
